newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy 10-yr Btp/Bund spread at new low of 89 bps.
newsitem.headline: Italy 10-yr Btp/Bund spread at new low of 89 bps.

text.p: The spread between the 10-year Italian Btp government bond and the benchmark Bund narrowed to a new all-time low of 89 basis points on Monday morning.
The previous low had been 91 bps set on July 9.
At 0912 GMT, the February 2007 Btp was 13 bps up at 102.88, yielding 6.43 percent, after an earlier high at 103.05. The spread was at 90 bps.
